records.source: Matplotlib's toolbar icon engine multiplies the size Qt asks for by the device pixel ratio, and Qt has already done so; above 1 the two cancel, below 1 (a user's ``QT_SCALE_FACTOR`` under 1) they compound. records.source: In place is sound for both, which is why there is no convert step. A sibling set differs from a nested one only in where its masks folder is, so passing that folder is the whole change. A bundle is rewritten with every key it already had kept, ``masks`` replaced, and the two keys derived from the masks -- ``outlines`` and ``ismanual`` -- brought up to date with it (see :func:`save_seg_bundle`); that is what the external curation tool did to the same files, less its stale outlines. A convert step would have been a second copy of every field, and the curator would have had to remember which copy was the truth.
